messages.subject: Triple i Logistics | Regional logistics, partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Triple i Logistics Leadership Team,

Triple i's integrated air, sea, inland and supply-chain platform aligns closely with my experience in complex industrial logistics and country stakeholder management.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

My work requires coordination across logistics, aviation, contractors, regulators, security and technical teams in a remote industrial setting. I also bring renewable-energy and carbon-governance experience that supports the growing sustainability agenda in supply chains.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Strategic Partnerships, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations or country operations. I have attached a Triple i Logistics-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
